definitions.explanation: A subject or issue to be discussed at a meeting or conference.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{議題|ぎだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}ります→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: Let's move on to the next agenda item.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{議題|ぎだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are three items on today's agenda.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{議題|ぎだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The budget issue came up as an agenda item, but no conclusion was reached.

notes:
{議題|ぎだい} refers to items formally put forward for discussion in a meeting.

FORMS:
{議|ぎ} (deliberation) + {題|だい} (topic, subject)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {議題|ぎだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to come up as an agenda item
- {議題|ぎだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to move to the agenda items
- {議題|ぎだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to set the agenda
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{議題|ぎだい}: next item on the agenda

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧: topic of conversation (casual)
- {議題|ぎだい}: formal discussion topic (meetings)
- ⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧: task, issue to be addressed
